environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 instances in a public subnet. S3 access is via public internet endpoint. Redis (ElastiCache) is accessible from the application subnet. No authentication is required on PUT/DELETE endpoints (DRF permission_classes defaults to AllowAny). The CATALOG_BUCKET is 'prod-catalog-store' with a permissive bucket policy allowing PutObject from any principal with valid credentials. The application IAM role has s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on the catalog bucket.

config.network: Public subnet, internet-facing ALB, no WAF
config.redis: ElastiCache Redis 6.x, no AUTH, same VPC
config.bucket_policy: Allows PutObject from catalog-api-role without conditions
